item.description:

After her mother is sentenced to life in a hilltop prison, Suzanna vows to return to the hill forever in this eerie, dreamlike, funny, psychologically acute fable (The Paris Review). item.title: Breathe With Me: Fireside Chat + Restorative Experience — Thu Sep 17, 7:00 PM — 80 Maple Ave Montclair NJ
item.description: An Evening of Breathwork, Restorative Yoga, Fireside Chat & Book Signing Join Loopwell for a restorative evening inspired by Breathe With Me, the bestselling book by renowned Kundalini yoga teacher, breathwork expert, and author Karena Virginia. Blending ancient wisdom with modern neuroscience, this immersive experience explores how conscious breathing helps regulate the nervous system, quiet the mind, and create space for greater resilience, clarity, and emotional well-being. Through guided breathwork, restorative yoga, healing sound, and a fireside chat moderated by Debbie Looney, Founder & CEO of Loopwell, you’ll experience simple, evidence-informed practices that can be integrated into everyday life. Whether you’re seeking relief from stress, deeper calm, or meaningful connection, this evening offers space to pause, restore, and breathe. Together we’ll experience: Guided breathwork to calm and regulate the nervous system Restorative yoga and mindful movement Deeply relaxing

item.title: Beyond Beginner Mah Jongg - Thu Evening - BAB — Thu Sep 24, 5:30 PM — Montclair Bellevue Ave Branch - Classroom
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
You learned the basics, what's next? In this class, we will go over Charleston strategies, how to pick a hand, when to expose or when to wait plus learn some skill building exercises you can do at home. Whether you’re looking to enhance your game or simply gain confidence, this is your chance to build on the skills that you learned in the Beginner class and get to the next level.
NOTE: If you know you cannot attend any of the first 3 sessions, please do not register for this class.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306
